title: When the Scholarship Wakes
premise: At Meridian Prep, Silas Okafor's bread literally tastes like feelings—grief, joy, dread—and everyone pretends not to notice. When his history teacher pairs him with his nemesis, wealthy, untouchable Juniper Vale, for a semester project on local archives, the two uncover a decades-old scholarship fund the school board quietly redirected to line its own pockets, erasing generations of working-class students. As Silas's bread starts tasting of other people's buried guilt, he and Juniper race to expose the truth before the board's final vote seals the archive forever. In the end, Silas chooses justice over his own hard-won scholarship spot, Juniper betrays her family's legacy to testify, and the fund is restored—but only after Silas nearly loses everything, including Juniper, and learns that some things must be broken open to rise.
about_author: Sable Thackeray is a former night-shift baker who claims her best plot ideas arrive around 4 a.m. while proofing dough. She writes young adult stories about small towns, large secrets, and the quiet magic hiding in ordinary hands.

chapters.title: The Taste of Fine
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. He bakes a 'everything is fine' loaf for his father's struggling bakery while hiding that his family's scholarship application to Meridian Prep is hanging by a thread. Establishes his bread-feelings gift as a family secret. Beat: anxious denial dressed as optimism.

chapters.title: Assigned
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Ms. Ferreira pairs him with Juniper Vale—his tormentor since freshman year—for the semester-long Meridian Archives project. Their classroom clash is electric; Juniper is coldly brilliant, Silas is furious. Beat: dread with a spark of unwilling fascination.

chapters.title: Juniper's Ledger
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. At home, her grandfather—a school board titan—praises her 'family project' and hands her a key to the archive wing. She realizes the assignment was engineered. Beat: the first crack in her loyalty, hidden behind perfect posture.

chapters.title: Breadcrumbs
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. In the archive basement, they find a 1971 scholarship ledger with names crossed out and redirected funds. Silas's bread, baked that night, tastes of someone else's shame. Beat: curiosity curdling into unease.

chapters.title: The Vale Name
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. She discovers her grandfather's name on the first redirected disbursement. She says nothing to Silas, testing whether she can bury it. Beat: guilt she can't bake away.

chapters.title: Sourdough and Secrets
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Forced late-night project sessions at the bakery thaw into something almost friendly. Juniper eats his bread and tastes his loneliness; he sees her flinch. Beat: enemies softening, walls thinning.

chapters.title: The Vanishing Cohort
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. She cross-references the erased scholars and finds they all left school abruptly in the same years. Her grandfather catches her in his study. Beat: fear wearing a polite smile.

chapters.title: Burnt Offerings
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. The bakery's oven 'fails' the day after he photographs documents; his father's loan is mysteriously called in. Silas suspects pressure, not coincidence. Beat: the cost of digging becomes personal.

chapters.title: What the Bread Knows
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. A loaf baked near Juniper tastes of terror and a memory of a fire. He confronts her; she admits a scholar's records were burned decades ago—maybe the scholar too. Beat: the stakes turn from money to lives.

chapters.title: Truce
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. She and Silas form a secret pact: finish the investigation before the board's centennial vote. She gives him her grandfather's spare archive key. Beat: alliance sealed with trembling trust.

chapters.title: The Understudy
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. A classmate, Dev, who's been snooping, is suddenly expelled on fabricated grounds. Silas realizes the board removes threats—and he's next. Beat: paranoia sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: Grandfather's House
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. Searching her grandfather's study, she finds the original endowment deed and a letter from the last erased scholar, begging for help. Her hands shake. Beat: love for family colliding with love of truth.

chapters.title: Rising
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. He and Juniper grow close; a near-kiss interrupted by a text from her grandfather. Silas's bread that morning tastes of want and dread in equal measure. Beat: love against duty, both pulling.

chapters.title: The Offer
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. Her grandfather offers Silas a full-ride scholarship—contingent on the project 'concluding cleanly.' Juniper must deliver the bribe herself. Beat: the cruelest test, aimed at both of them.

chapters.title: Silas Says No
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. He refuses the scholarship publicly in front of Ms. Ferreira, choosing the erased scholars over his own future. His father, furious and proud, backs him. Beat: the theme made flesh—justice over survival.

chapters.title: Fracture
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. Silas's refusal exposes that she delivered the bribe; he feels betrayed. They split days before the vote, each convinced the other chose the wrong side. Beat: heartbreak as consequence, not misunderstanding.

chapters.title: Ash in the Archive
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. The archive basement is set ablaze overnight; the ledger survives only because Silas smuggled it out days earlier. He realizes Juniper warned him with a burnt-tasting loaf left at his door. Beat: betrayal and loyalty tangled together.

chapters.title: The Vote
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. At the centennial board meeting, she walks in, takes the microphone, and testifies against her own grandfather with the deed and the letter as evidence. Beat: the climax—duty broken, truth spoken.

chapters.title: What the Board Buried
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Silas presents the surviving ledger and the burned scholars' names, his voice shaking. The room turns; the vote collapses; an investigation is called. Beat: justice won at full volume.

chapters.title: Aftertaste
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. Fallout: her grandfather resigns under investigation, her family cuts her off, and she moves in temporarily with Silas's family above the bakery. Grief and relief share a table. Beat: the price of doing right.

chapters.title: The Fund Wakes
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. The scholarship fund is restored and named for the erased scholars; Silas, having burned his own spot, receives a community-funded award instead. He bakes a loaf for every name read aloud. Beat: restoration, earned not given.

chapters.title: Warm Bread, Open Door
chapters.summary: Dual POV, alternating. Spring semester: Silas and Juniper, rebuilt slowly and honestly, co-lead the new student archive collective. The last scene is them baking together, the bread tasting of something new—hope. Beat: love and justice, finally in the same oven.
